key_phrases: AI accelerator revenue to double in 2025
CapEx budget $38 billion to $42 billion for 2025
long-term revenue growth approach a 20% CAGR
2% to 3% margin dilution from overseas fabs
analysis.reasoning: The overall sentiment is highly optimistic, driven by explosive AI demand and clear long-term growth targets (20% CAGR). Management shows high confidence with specific technology roadmaps (N2, A16) and aggressive CapEx expansion ($38B-$42B). While there is a transparent disclosure of margin risks due to overseas expansion and inflation, the company demonstrates strong pricing power (US premium) and an unshakeable competitive moat. QA was direct on technical/business matters, though slightly evasive on US political/regulatory specifics, which is standard for the company.
